def MathResearch.Spinor.regularRepresentation : (n : ℕ) →
  (hn : 2 ≤ n) → Sp11 →* ↥(WeakBallSpace n hn) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] ↥(WeakBallSpace n hn) :=
fun n hn => { toFun := regularUnitary n hn, map_one' := ⋯, map_mul' := ⋯ }
def MathResearch.Spinor.regularRowRepresentation : (m : ℕ) →
  (hm : 1 ≤ m) → Sp11 →* ↥(weakRowKernel m hm) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] ↥(weakRowKernel m hm) :=
fun m hm => { toFun := regularRowUnitary m hm, map_one' := ⋯, map_mul' := ⋯ }
def MathResearch.Spinor.regularRowUnitary : (m : ℕ) →
  (hm : 1 ≤ m) → Sp11 → ↥(weakRowKernel m hm) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] ↥(weakRowKernel m hm) :=
fun m hm g =>
  ((weakSpinorIsometry m hm).symm.trans ((regularRepresentation (m + 1) ⋯) g)).trans (weakSpinorIsometry m hm)
def MathResearch.Spinor.rowBallRepresentation : (m : ℕ) →
  QuaternionMatrix2 → (ℍ → Fin (m + 1) → ℍ) → ℍ → Fin (m + 1) → ℍ :=
fun m g => rowBallAction m (signatureAdjoint g)
def MathResearch.Spinor.rowBallAction : (m : ℕ) → QuaternionMatrix2 → (ℍ → Fin (m + 1) → ℍ) → ℍ → Fin (m + 1) → ℍ :=
fun m a h q k =>
  (Quaternion.normSq (mobiusDenominator a q))⁻¹ •
    ((mobiusDenominator a q)⁻¹ * rowSubstitution m (quaternionMatrix (mobiusDenominator a q)⁻¹) (h (mobiusPoint a q)) k)
def MathResearch.Spinor.rowSubstitution : (m : ℕ) → Matrix2 → (Fin (m + 1) → ℍ) → Fin (m + 1) → ℍ :=
fun m M h k => ∑ l, h l * ↑((coefficientActionMatrix m M).transpose l k)
def MathResearch.Spinor.RowDistributionRegular : (m : ℕ) → ↥(CompatibleBallL2 m) → Prop :=
fun m h => ∀ (φ : BallTest) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), rowWeakTest m h φ d = 0
def MathResearch.Spinor.rowWeakTest : (m : ℕ) → ↥(CompatibleBallL2 m) → BallTest → (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) → ℍ :=
fun m h φ d =>
  ∑ μ,
    MathResearch.Fueter.coordinateBasis μ *
      ∫ (q : ℍ) in Ball, ((testDirectional (MathResearch.Fueter.coordinateBasis μ)) φ) q • rowCoefficient m d (↑↑h q)
theorem MathResearch.Spinor.rowWeakTest_eq_distribution : ∀ (m : ℕ),
  1 ≤ m →
    ∀ (h : ↥(CompatibleBallL2 m)) (φ : BallTest) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
      rowWeakTest m h φ d =
        -∑ μ,
            MathResearch.Fueter.coordinateBasis μ *
              ((Distribution.lineDerivCLM (MathResearch.Fueter.coordinateBasis μ))
                  (Distribution.ofFun ballOpen (fun q => rowCoefficient m d (↑↑h q)) volume ⊤))
                φ :=
